title: Add NVD API key hint when NVD feed fails with HTTP 429 rate limit in Settings Threat Intel
goal: In the Settings Threat Intel section, when the NVD CVE feed status shows HTTP 429 or reason=rate_limited, display an actionable hint below the error text: 'NVD rate-limits unauthenticated requests. Configure an NVD API key in Settings to increase your quota.' with a link or scroll anchor to the nvd_api_key input field. The nvd_api_key setting already exists in the settings schema. This task is UI-only - no backend changes needed.
scope: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: Settings shows NVD feed failing with HTTP 429. No API key hint.
generation_reason: Walkthrough 2026-04-30: Settings shows NVD feed failing with HTTP 429. No API key hint.
